items.tr: çok kolay geçmek, su gibi halletmek
items.example: She breezed through the interview.
items.exampleTr: Mülakatı su gibi geçti.
items.simple: You do something hard very easily.
dialogue: A: Were you nervous about the exam?
B: Not really. I expected to breeze through it.
items.note: Sınav, mülakat, görev için; zahmetsiz başarıyı vurgular.

items.example: I need to buckle down and finish this report.
items.exampleTr: Ciddi ciddi oturup bu raporu bitirmem lazım.
items.simple: Stop playing and start working hard.
dialogue: A: Exams start in two weeks.
B: I know. Time to buckle down.
items.note: Ertelemeyi bırakıp ciddileşmeyi anlatır.

items.example: He's buttering up the boss before asking for a raise.
items.exampleTr: Zam istemeden önce patrona yağ çekiyor.
items.simple: Say nice things to someone so they will help you.
dialogue: A: Why are you making me breakfast?
B: Can't I butter up my favourite sister?
items.note: Bir şey istemeden önce birini övmek; hafif alaycı.

items.tr: seri üretmek, peş peşe çıkarmak (çoğu zaman özensizce)
items.example: That studio churns out the same kind of film every year.
items.exampleTr: O stüdyo her yıl aynı tür filmi seri üretiyor.
items.simple: Make lots of something fast, often not very good.
dialogue: A: How many emails do you write a day?
B: I churn out about fifty, I reckon.
items.note: Nitelikten çok niceliği eleştirirken.

items.tr: derme çatma bir şey ortaya çıkarmak
items.example: We cobbled together a dinner from whatever was in the fridge.
items.exampleTr: Buzdolabında ne varsa ondan derme çatma bir akşam yemeği çıkardık.
items.simple: Make something quickly from whatever you have.
dialogue: A: Did you have time to prepare the slides?
B: I managed to cobble together something last night.
items.note: Hızlı ve özensiz hazırlanmış plan, yemek, sunum için.

items.example: My old car finally conked out on the motorway.
items.exampleTr: Eski arabam sonunda otoyolda bozulup kaldı.
items.simple: A machine stops working, or a tired person falls asleep.
dialogue: A: Is the printer working again?
B: It printed two pages and then decided to conk out.
items.note: Gündelik, esprili; makineler ve yorgun insanlar için.

items.example: It took me ages to cotton on that they were dating.
items.exampleTr: Çıktıklarını çakmam çok uzun sürdü.
items.simple: Finally understand something that was a bit hidden.
dialogue: A: Did he know it was a surprise party?
B: No, he didn't cotton on until he opened the door.
items.note: İngiliz İngilizcesi; genelde 'cotton on to' biçimiyle.

items.example: He loves dishing out advice, but he never takes any.
items.exampleTr: Herkese akıl vermeye bayılır ama kendisi hiç almaz.
items.simple: Give lots of something to people, like advice or criticism.
dialogue: A: Why is he so upset about one joke?
B: He can dish out criticism, but he can't take it.
items.note: 'He can dish it out but he can't take it' kalıbı çok yaygın.

items.example: Why do you always dredge up stuff from ten years ago?
items.exampleTr: Neden hep on yıl önceki şeyleri eşeliyorsun?
items.simple: Talk again about an old bad thing that should stay forgotten.
dialogue: A: Remember when you forgot my birthday in 2015?
B: Please don't dredge up the past again.
items.note: Kavgalarda eski hataları ortaya dökmek için.

items.example: We handed out flyers to drum up some business.
items.exampleTr: Biraz iş getirmek için el ilanı dağıttık.
items.simple: Work hard to get people interested or to help.
dialogue: A: Not many people have signed up for the quiz night.
B: Let's post on the group chat to drum up some interest.
items.note: Genelde 'drum up support/business/interest' ile.

items.example: I ducked out of the meeting early to pick up my son.
items.exampleTr: Oğlumu almak için toplantıdan erken sıvıştım.
items.simple: Leave quietly or avoid doing something.
dialogue: A: Where's Mike?
B: He tried to duck out of the washing-up again.
items.note: Toplantı, görev veya sorumluluktan kaçmak için.

items.tr: kıt kanaat idare etmek, zar zor çıkarmak
items.example: I'm trying to eke out my savings until I find a job.
items.exampleTr: İş bulana kadar birikimimi idareli kullanmaya çalışıyorum.
items.simple: Make a small amount last a long time.
dialogue: A: How are you managing without a salary?
B: Just about. I'm trying to eke out what's left.
items.note: 'eke out a living' = zar zor geçimini sağlamak.

items.example: It's good to have some savings to fall back on.
items.exampleTr: Kenarda başvurabileceğin biraz birikim olması iyidir.
items.simple: Use something when your first plan does not work.
dialogue: A: Why study accounting if you want to be an actor?
B: So I've got something to fall back on.
items.note: Yedek plan, birikim, eski beceri için.

items.example: The conversation just fizzled out after a while.
items.exampleTr: Bir süre sonra sohbet öylece söndü gitti.
items.simple: Something slowly stops, with no big ending.
dialogue: A: Are you still seeing that guy from the gym?
B: No, things kind of started to fizzle out.
items.note: İlişki, heves, sohbet, proje için.

items.example: He frittered away his inheritance on cars.
items.exampleTr: Mirasını arabalara çarçur etti.
items.simple: Waste money or time on small, silly things.
dialogue: A: I got a bonus this month!
B: Nice. Don't fritter away all of it on takeaways.
items.note: Azar azar boşa harcamayı anlatır.

items.example: The shops are gearing up for the Christmas rush.
items.exampleTr: Mağazalar Noel yoğunluğuna hazırlanıyor.
items.simple: Get ready for something big that is coming.
dialogue: A: Why is everyone working late?
B: We have to gear up for the product launch.
items.note: Yoğun bir dönem veya etkinlik öncesi hazırlık için.

items.example: I'm going to hole up at home and finish my thesis.
items.exampleTr: Evde kapanıp tezimi bitireceğim.
items.simple: Stay inside one place and hide from people for a while.
dialogue: A: Any plans for the weekend?
B: I'm going to hole up with a box set and pizza.
items.note: Gündelik; çalışmak veya kafa dinlemek için içeri kapanmak.

items.tr: sıkı durmak, sinip beklemek, kafayı işe vermek
items.example: We hunkered down and waited for the storm to pass.
items.exampleTr: Sinip fırtınanın geçmesini bekledik.
items.simple: Stay in a safe place and wait, or focus hard on work.
dialogue: A: The deadline is Monday.
B: Then let's hunker down and get it done this weekend.
items.note: Kötü dönemi atlatmak ya da yoğun çalışmak için.

items.example: A few cushions will jazz up the sofa.
items.exampleTr: Birkaç yastık koltuğa renk katar.
items.simple: Make something more fun, bright or interesting.
dialogue: A: This salad looks a bit boring.
B: Add some pomegranate to jazz up the colours.
items.note: Oda, kıyafet, sunum, yemek için.

items.example: Let's knock off early today, it's Friday.
items.exampleTr: Bugün erken paydos edelim, cuma.
items.simple: Stop working for the day.
dialogue: A: What time do you finish?
B: I usually knock off around five.
items.note: İngiliz İngilizcesi, gündelik; 'knock it off' = kes şunu.

items.example: The coach really laid into the players at half-time.
items.exampleTr: Antrenör devre arasında oyunculara resmen veryansın etti.
items.simple: Shout at someone or criticise them very angrily.
dialogue: A: Why is Emma crying?
B: Her boss decided to lay into her in front of everyone.
items.note: Sözlü saldırı; bazen fiziksel de olabilir.

items.example: The kids lapped up every word of the story.
items.exampleTr: Çocuklar hikayenin her kelimesini büyük keyifle dinledi.
items.simple: Enjoy something very much, like praise or attention.
dialogue: A: Is your dad enjoying his retirement party?
B: Oh, he'll lap up all the attention.
items.note: İlgi ve övgüye bayılmayı, bazen saflıkla inanmayı anlatır.

items.example: Level with me: are we in trouble?
items.exampleTr: Bana açık konuş: başımız dertte mi?
items.simple: Tell someone the full truth, even if it is bad.
dialogue: A: So, how bad is the damage?
B: I'll level with you. It's going to be expensive.
items.note: Özellikle 'I'll level with you' kalıbında.

items.example: I fell asleep at my own party and I'll never live it down.
items.exampleTr: Kendi partimde uyuyakaldım, bunu asla unutturamayacağım.
items.simple: Make people forget something silly you did. Often you can't.
dialogue: A: You called the teacher 'Mum' in front of the whole class?
B: I know. I'll never live it down.
items.note: Neredeyse hep olumsuz: 'never live it down'.
